summary: Airport security police sim: scan luggage, check passports & catch criminals!
description:
Become the officer every flight depends on in Airport Security Simulator 3D - a detailed airport security and police simulation. Scan luggage, check passports and catch criminals before they reach the gate.

Every passenger is a puzzle and every decision keeps the airport safe. It is immersive and easy to jump into whenever you have a few minutes - and you can play completely offline, no internet needed.

YOUR SHIFT STARTS NOW
Your shift begins at a busy terminal. Run the X-ray scanner to detect weapons, drugs and banned items. Match passport photos, spot fake IDs and question suspicious travelers. When a 911 alarm sounds, respond fast and lock down restricted zones. This airport security simulator turns every checkpoint into a fresh challenge.

KEY FEATURES
• Realistic 3D airport with detailed terminals, gates and customs halls
• X-ray luggage scanning and cargo inspection
• Passport and ID document checks - catch the forgeries
• Criminal patrol: chase and arrest smugglers
• Trained K9 police dogs to sniff out contraband and explosives
• Emergency 911 response and checkpoint control
• Rank progression from rookie to Chief of Airport Police
• Daily missions and unlockable scanners and gear
• Offline gameplay supported - no WiFi required

HOW TO PLAY
Your job changes with every mission. One moment you are verifying documents at customs, the next you are chasing a smuggler across the terminal or leading a police dog unit during an emergency. Scan bags, inspect crew and passengers, manage terminal checkpoints and respond quickly to alarms. Each level brings tougher challenges, smarter criminals and new surprises, so no two shifts in this airport police simulator feel the same.

RISE THROUGH THE RANKS
Start your career as a rookie officer and earn promotions by completing missions. Unlock advanced scanners, new tools and access to bigger terminals. Prove your leadership, supervise teams and coordinate security across the city as Chief of Airport Police, responsible for the entire airport network.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
This is a complete airport security experience with authentic role-play, a calm and steady pace, and hands-on security duty. Enjoy detailed graphics, smooth controls and dynamic gameplay you can play anytime, anywhere. Realistic checkpoints and immersive 3D visuals set this airport simulator apart.

TIPS FOR SUCCESS
Watch body language, double-check every passport photo and never rush a scan - the smartest criminals hide in the smallest details. Keep your checkpoints moving to keep every flight on time and earn faster promotions.

Stay sharp, stay alert and protect every flight from takeoff to landing. Download Airport Security Simulator 3D now, secure the busiest terminals, prevent crime and prove you have what it takes.
Your city, your airport, your responsibility.
